question.question: How do Eyrie item crafting and its Builder leader interact with printed VP and extra crafting-point effects?

expected.expected_answer: Normally ignore printed VP and score one; extra crafting-point effects still apply. Builder ignores Disdain so printed VP applies.

source_passages.section: Actions — Eyrie Dynasties (7), Disdain for Trade and Builder
source_passages.quotation: **Lords of the Forest:** Win ties for rule if at least one Eyrie piece there. **Disdain for Trade:** Crafted items score only **one VP instead of printed VP** (other extra crafting-point effects still apply). Builder ignores Disdain.

source_passages.section: Actions — Shared movement, crafting and battle; Craft (4.1), item-card scoring
source_passages.quotation: - Immediate effect (paper box): resolve, then discard the **crafting card**. An item card requires the corresponding **item token** in the map supply, or it cannot be crafted. Take the item token into Crafted Items and score the VP printed on the card, subject to Eyrie exception. The item token stays; the crafting card is discarded. Ordinary factions do not exhaust crafted items as Vagabond does.

answer.ruling: When Eyrie crafts an item, it scores one VP instead of the printed VP. Other extra crafting-point effects still apply.
